vb_textbox.text: Try both colours initially to test the highest score, although the colour that yields the higher score will change throughout the game. I saw the scores change in waves - sometimes green would consistently score high, but as the score dropped below 5 I'd change to the opposing colour gnome to see if it scored higher. Sometimes both colours yield low scores so it feels more like trial and error, but other times you will find a good rhythm of high scores. For me green and brown gnomes felt they scored better generally.
